Cite the input filenames in report.md. report.json must be a single JSON object with north, south, total (integers), release_date (YYYY-MM-DD), pilot_approved (boolean), sources (input filenames), and findings (objects with kind, evidence and sources). Use finding kinds total_conflict, date_conflict, approval_missing where supported, and do not invent other findings. Explain each finding with concrete evidence. The two reports must agree. Do not modify inputs or invoke other Agent CLIs.
